title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array

plan.approach:
We perform a modified binary search that exploits the fact that the array is a rotated sorted array of distinct elements. At each iteration we examine the middle element `mid`. If `nums[mid]` equals the target we return `mid`. Otherwise we determine which half of the current interval is sorted: if `nums[left] <= nums[mid]` then the left half `[left, mid]` is sorted; otherwise the right half `[mid, right]` is sorted. Once we know which half is sorted, we check whether the target lies within that sorted half by comparing it to the boundary values. If it does, we narrow the search to that half; otherwise we search the other half. We repeat until the interval is empty, returning -1 if the target is not found. This algorithm runs in O(log n) time and uses O(1) additional space.

Pseudo-code:
```
left, right = 0, len(nums)-1
while left <= right:
    mid = (left+right)//2
    if nums[mid] == target:
        return mid
    if nums[left] <= nums[mid]:  # left half sorted
        if nums[left] <= target < nums[mid]:
            right = mid-1
        else:
            left = mid+1
    else:  # right half sorted
        if nums[mid] < target <= nums[right]:
            left = mid+1
        else:
            right = mid-1
return -1
```

This logic correctly handles all rotations, including no rotation, full rotation, and single-element arrays.
edge_cases:
Empty array (though constraints say length ≥ 1) – should return -1.
Single-element array – works correctly.
Array not rotated (pivot at index 0).
Array rotated by n-1 positions (pivot at last index).
Target equals first element.
Target equals last element.
Target not present.
Target is less than all elements (wrap-around case).
Target is greater than all elements (wrap-around case).
Negative numbers in array and target.
Large array size up to 5000 – algorithm still O(log n).
plan.complexity_target: O(n log n) Time, O(1) Space

final_code:
from typing import List

def search(nums: List[int], target: int) -> int:
    """
    Search for target in a rotated sorted array of distinct integers.

    Parameters
    ----------
    nums : List[int]
        Rotated sorted array.
    target : int
        Value to search for.

    Returns
    -------
    int
        Index of target if found, otherwise -1.
    """
    if not nums:
        return -1

    left, right = 0, len(nums) - 1
    while left <= right:
        mid = (left + right) // 2
        mid_val = nums[mid]
        if mid_val == target:
            return mid

        # Determine which half is sorted
        if nums[left] <= mid_val:  # left half sorted
            if nums[left] <= target < mid_val:
                right = mid - 1
            else:
                left = mid + 1
        else:  # right half sorted
            if mid_val < target <= nums[right]:
                left = mid + 1
            else:
                right = mid - 1

    return -1
